project_type: Vite React SPA monorepo with TypeScript
build_system: Vite 5.4.2 + npm workspaces. Each app has independent build. No shared build orchestration at root level.
test_framework: vitest (configured but binaries not installed; tests run with --passWithNoTests)
build_command: cd apps/staff-portal && npm run build (runs tsc && vite build)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build in apps/staff-portal. Expected: dist/ folder created with index.html and compiled JS/CSS assets. No TypeScript errors.
environment_constraints: Apps use Vite env vars (VITE_API_URL). Default: http://localhost:3000/api/v1. No .env.example files exist in apps; env vars defined inline in api.ts files. admin-panel has @ path alias pointing to ./src via vite.config.ts; operator-dashboard does not use path aliases.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md. Follow existing project conventions: strict:false TypeScript, inline CSS for admin-panel, Tailwind CSS for operator-dashboard, react-i18next for translations.
key_patterns: admin-panel: Context API (AuthContext), inline styles, single i18n.ts with embedded translations. operator-dashboard: Zustand store (auth.ts), Tailwind CSS utility classes, separate i18n/ folder with en.json/sw.json, axios for API, lucide-react icons. Both: react-router-dom v6, RequireAuth wrapper, Layout with Sidebar.
directory_structure: daladala/apps/ contains passenger-app, driver-app, operator-dashboard, admin-panel, web-platform. services/ contains api-gateway (Node.js/TypeScript Express). packages/ contains shared-types. Each app is self-contained with src/pages, src/components, src/services, index.html, main.tsx.
